name: Double Arch Reef
description: Two natural arches, one stacked above the other, about 200 m off Xwejni Bay. The reef top is at 15–18 m, the arches start at 20 m, it's 34 m under the arches and the reef ends at about 45 m. Barracuda shoals are common. Can be done from shore with a long surface swim.
conditions: Best in flat calm; easterly winds blow it out.
